welcomeParagraph: The Mobilis Smart POS app is designed to transform sales points (POS) by integrating digitization and automation into the sales process. With this app, you can manage identity verifications efficiently and securely, simplifying operations and enhancing customer experience.
primaryFunctionalities:
- Fast and Secure Registration
- Data Automation
- Real-time Tracking
- Enhanced Security
conditionsOfUse: Terms of Use and Legal Aspect
condition1: The use of the Mobilis Smart POS app is subject to the following conditions:
condition3: Users must ensure the confidentiality of customers' personal and sensitive information. Any breach of this confidentiality may result in legal actions.
condition5: The app must be used solely for legitimate and authorized purposes. Any fraudulent or unauthorized use is strictly prohibited.
condition7: Users must comply with all applicable local, national, and international laws and regulations. This includes, but is not limited to, data protection laws and anti-money laundering regulations.
condition9: Users are responsible for all activities conducted under their account. They must ensure that their login credentials are secure and not shared with third parties.
condition11: Mobilis reserves the right to update or modify the app at any time to enhance its features and security. Users will be informed of any significant updates.
